name: fix-missing-template-depends
body: source: dependency graph among requirements; inconsistency: three consumes-relationships were implied by the bodies but missing as depends-on edges (feedback-7); resolution [autonomous, each verified against the requirement bodies]: number-date-formats → template-build-checks (the reserved `_format` suffix is enforced by the build-time checks); slide-template-required → template-definition (`template:` must name a defined slide-usage template); section-frontmatter → template-composition (whether `template:` is required depends on how many section templates the section accepts, which composition declares). No cycles introduced (binary-enforced acyclic).
